trial.captures: Local only, .debug/recognition_frames_candidate, capped at 150 per service process.
trial.fallback: Close candidate service and launch run_ai_server.bat for original model.

limitations: Single phone photograph is a development challenge example, not a statistically independent accuracy benchmark. Green Draw Two remains missed in this photo.
Public test covers 52 of 54 classes and may overlap the historical baseline training corpus. mAP50 improved but mAP50-95 regressed.
Qualitative Quest frame previews include number confusions and background false detections; no ground-truth Quest accuracy is claimed.
Timing is median of five warmed GPU calls and excludes image decoding, USB, client capture and voting.
A direct standalone Quest AB run is still required; no APK rebuild is needed.
